method: Manual visual digitization of manufacturer chart; RGB ordered cyan/magenta/yellow forming layers. Numerical observations only, no manufacturer LUT. Piecewise linear interpolation.

conditions.sensitivity: 1/50 second, C-41, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min

uncertainty.status: visual reading estimates, not statistical confidence intervals

missing_for_physical_model: No scene exposure, scene reflectance spectra, actual GR3 sensor/ISP calibration, batch/development/scan calibration. Manufacturer dye-density chart exists but this display adaptation does not model optical negative scanning.
